title: Filter workflow events reference solution

answer.approach: A complete response for filter workflow events should include: push:, branches:, pull_request:.
answer.example:
name: Scoped validation
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "src/**"
      - "tests/**"
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo "Run scoped validation here"
answer.verification: Push runs are limited by branch and changed-path filters; pull requests targeting main run the validation job.
